description: Test suite for verifying battery status UI updates and API calls using Playwright with mock battery data.

classes.name: BatteryMock
classes.description: A mock class simulating the Battery API for testing purposes, with methods to set battery level and charging status and manage event listeners.

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Adds event listeners for 'chargingchange' and 'levelchange' events.

methods.name: _setLevel
methods.description: Sets the battery level and triggers level change event listeners.

methods.name: _setCharging
methods.description: Sets the charging status and triggers charging change event listeners.
